pr_title: streamingccl: store replicated time in details
pr_body:
The cutover process uses the progress field to record how many ranges need to be reverted. This, however, wipes out the high watermark that was previously stored in that progress field.

Here, we move the canonical copy of the high watermark to the progress details.

For clarity, we rename "high watermark" as "replicated time".

Further, we delete a long skipped test that isn't providing much value.

Fixes #103534

Epic: none

Release note: None

issue_context.title: c2c: cutover is not resilient to node shutdown
issue_context.body:
If the coordinator node issuing revert range requests during cutover fails over, another node will be not able to resume the work. This occurs because the current implementation of cutover [uses](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/ccl/streamingccl/streamingest/stream_ingestion_job.go#L682) the the job progress FractionCompleted oneOf f[ield](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/53afe66d3d4d3b1647f3fcda73fe0e66833e81eb/pkg/jobs/jobspb/jobs.proto#L1299). Sadly, during regular ingestion, we use the progress high_water field, so when cutover begins, we write over the job progress's high water mark.

When a node then tries to resume cutover after the og coordinator dies, it can't, because it attempts to check the high water mark which is unreadible.

This was seen https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/103008#issuecomment-1549767358


Jira issue: CRDB-28065

Epic CRDB-25146

review_comments: when would this occur? Like before the job info table migration? If you don't know off the top of your head, I can do some digging.
I would hope the only happen is during the migration which shouldn't really be that relevant for us.
curious: why did you move this codeblock?
It needed to be under the definition of streamProgress so that we could be sure to set both at the same time.
as I've said elsewhere, I wonder if we should not record the HighWater in Progress.
I'm not sure we even want to record the hwm, as it opens the door to foot guns.
